label: Capacity_Disclaimer
limits: Label edges cover Apex only — references from Flows, LWC, Aura and formulas are not read, so an unreferenced label means unreferenced from Apex, not safe to delete.

Dynamic reads (System.Label.get with a computed name) come from the last coverage run: a read on a path that run did not execute is not here, and one recorded before the code changed may no longer happen.
Readers are the classes naming the label; anything reaching those classes appears as a transitive dependent, not as a reader.
